title: OpenAI chat client -> Claude upstream - golden recording request

config_instances.default: config template from reports/oracle/BOOTSTRAP.md section 3 as currently in _cpa_edge_ref/run/config.yaml; it already wires claude-api-key -> http://host.docker.internal:19002 (api-key mock-claue-key value irrelevant, model 'claude-mock-model', alias 'cm'). No instance changes needed for S2d3.

secrets_note: <api-key> = oracle-local-key-1 (gateway auth). Upstream credential value mock-claude-key comes from the config; upstream wire logs redact Authorization. <port> = 18317.

mock_upstream.config_entry: claude-api-key: [{api-key: mock-claude-key, base-url: http://host.docker.internal:19002, models: [{name: claude-mock-model, alias: cm}]}] (already in run/config.yaml)

ordering_constraints: Reset the control file to happy ({"mode":"happy"}) before every case unless the case specifies otherwise; each multi-step case lists per-step control contents.
Case 14 (429 -> cooldown) poisons the credential for ~1s: run it LAST among cases on the default instance, and send its step 2 immediately (<1s) after step 1.
Case 15 must not run within ~1s after case 14's step 1 (avoid cooldown interference).
Cases 1-13 and 16-18 are order-independent; recommended order is the numeric case order.
Every request re-reads the control file fresh; no mock restart needed between cases (the mock is stateless besides the control file).
record_format: Per case directory tests/fixtures/S2d3/<case-id>/: meta.yaml (anchor, date, client protocol=openai chat, upstream provider type=claude-api-key, stream flag, config fragment, dynamic fields), request.http (exact bytes sent, one per step, suffixed), downstream.md per step (status, response headers, exact body bytes - for SSE the full frame stream), upstream.jsonl (per step: what the reference emitted to the mock - method, path, headers, body; this is the primary gold for request-translation cases), mock-response.json (the scripted reply / control file contents that drove the recording).
dynamic_fields_common: downstream created (server epoch) in JSON bodies and chat.completion.chunk frames
metadata.user_id - deterministic sha256 per request content; keep bytes, mask only if they vary

cases.purpose: Pin the minimal happy path, client stream:false: upstream wire (POST {base}/v1/messages?beta=true, headers incl. Bearer auth + Anthropic-Version 2023-06-01 + caller UA + Accept-Encoding identity; body = {model:'claude-mock-model', max_tokens:32000, messages:[user text with cache_control ephemeral on the block], metadata.user_id = sha256('content:Say hello'), stream:true}) and downstream 200 chat.completion (id/model from upstream message, created=server epoch, content concatenated, usage 9/6/15, finish_reason stop).
cases.record: status+headers+body downstream; upstream.jsonl full request line (the gold). Note: expect metadata.user_id exactly 120226d8c5cb65e3acdd1f5e56fb3cf04f8bf909fe34ece9118dcc2d0e8b6c46 (sha256 of 'content:Say hello') - if it differs, record actual and flag.
cases.notes: Proven end-to-end already (probes/mocks/claude/t1); re-record into the fixture layout.

cases.purpose: Pin the SSE downstream shape for the happy path: headers (text/event-stream, no-cache, keep-alive, CORS), then data: lines: role chunk (delta.role assistant), one content chunk per text_delta, message_delta chunk (delta:{}, finish_reason 'stop', usage attached), trailing usage chunk (choices:[]), then data: [DONE]. Upstream event: lines are consumed and never forwarded.

cases.notes: Proven end-to-end already (t2). Re-record into fixture layout.

cases.purpose: Pin header rules: (a) client sends NO User-Agent -> upstream User-Agent falls back to 'CLIProxyAPI/v7.3.4'; (b) client sends Anthropic-Beta 'custom-beta-2026-01-01' and Anthropic-Version '2024-10-01' -> both forwarded upstream verbatim (Anthropic-Version not overridden by the 2023-06-01 default).
cases.record: both steps: status+headers+body + upstream.jsonl (upstream headers are the gold here: step1 User-Agent=CLIProxyAPI/v7.3.4, step2 Anthropic-Beta + Anthropic-Version=2024-10-01).
dynamic_fields: metadata.user_id (different content per step -> recomputable sha256)
cases.notes: curl -H 'User-Agent:' sends NO User-Agent header (empty value removes it).

cases.purpose: Pin parameter handling with a system message: system role -> top-level system array [{type:text,text:'You are helpful.'}] with default cache_control ephemeral on the LAST system block; temperature 0.7 and top_p 0.9 DELETED upstream (never on the wire); max_tokens 777 overrides the 32000 default; stop array -> stop_sequences ['END']. Step 2 pins stop as a plain string -> stop_sequences ['STOP'].
cases.record: both steps: status+headers+body + upstream.jsonl. Golds: step1 upstream body key order model,max_tokens,messages,metadata,stop_sequences,stream,system (NO temperature, NO top_p); system block carries cache_control; step2 stop_sequences ['STOP'] and max_tokens 50 (max_completion_tokens alias accepted).
cases.notes: presence_penalty/n/presence fields must NOT appear upstream. Downstream bodies are the canned happy response - fine.

cases.purpose: Pin content-part translation: OpenAI content array [text, image_url data-URL, image_url http URL] -> Claude blocks [{type:text,text:...},{type:image,source:{type:base64,media_type:image/png,data:<b64>}},{type:image,source:{type:url,url:http://example.test/cat.png}}]. cases.purpose: Pin the tools round-trip in one upstream body: tools[function] -> {name, description, input_schema} with normalized+key-sorted schema; tool_choice 'auto' -> {type:auto}; assistant message with tool_calls -> tool_use block appended after its text block; tool role message -> user tool_result message; consecutive user/tool-result + next user message MERGE into one user turn [tool_result, text]; default cache_control: last tool + last block of the last message (system absent).

requests.curl: curl -sS -v http://127.0.0.1:18317/v1/chat/completions -H 'Authorization: Bearer <api-key>' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"cm","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Weather in Paris?"},{"role":"assistant","content":"Let me check.","tool_calls":[{"id":"call_01","type":"function","function":{"name":"get_weather","arguments":"{\"city\":\"Paris\"}"}}]},{"role":"tool","tool_call_id":"call_01","content":"20C and sunny"},{"role":"user","content":"Thanks, and in Berlin?"}],"tools":[{"type":"function","function":{"name":"get_weather","description":"Get current weather","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"city":{"type":"string"}},"required":["city"]}}}],"tool_choice":"auto"}'

cases.record: status+headers+body + upstream.jsonl. Golds: upstream messages = [user text, assistant [text 'Let me check.', tool_use call_01], user [tool_result call_01 '20C and sunny', text 'Thanks, and in Berlin?']]; tools[0] = {name,description,input_schema:{properties,required,type}} (lexicographic keys); tool_choice {type:auto}; cache_control on tools[0] and on the LAST content block of the LAST message.

cases.purpose: Pin developer role + response_format handling: 'developer' and 'system' messages BOTH become top-level system blocks in message order (developer first, then system); the response_format json_schema INSTRUCTION block is APPENDED LAST among system blocks; the default cache_control lands on that LAST system block (the instruction). Pin the exact instruction text.

requests.curl: curl -sS -v http://127.0.0.1:18317/v1/chat/completions -H 'Authorization: Bearer <api-key>' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"cm","messages":[{"role":"developer","content":"Always answer in English."},{"role":"system","content":"You are a JSON generator."},{"role":"user","content":"Give me a person"}],"response_format":{"type":"json_schema","json_schema":{"name":"person","schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"name":{"type":"string"}},"required":["name"]}}}}'

cases.record: status+headers+body + upstream.jsonl. Golds: system = 3 blocks [developer text, system text, instruction text]; instruction text starts 'You must format your entire response as valid JSON that conforms strictly to the following JSON schema:' followed by 'Schema Name: person' and the raw schema JSON; cache_control ONLY on the last system block; messages = [user text] with its own default cache marker.

cases.purpose: Pin error passthrough + cooldown: step1 upstream 429 with claude-shaped JSON body -> downstream 429 with the SAME body bytes verbatim (status+body passthrough). step2 (immediately after, <1s) same request with mock reset to happy -> downstream 500 model_cooldown envelope {'error':{'code':'model_cooldown','last_upstream_error':'<verbatim 429 body>','message':'All credentials for model cm are cooling down via provider claude (last error: ...)'}}.

requests.timing: MUST be sent within 1s of step1 completing (cooldown window ~1s)
